description: This file defines interfaces for managing network bridge modes, including function declarations for controlling bridge actions and managing bridge states, along with necessary includes and licensing information.

methods.name: bridge_mode_ctrl_action
methods.description: Controls the bridge mode based on provided parameters, enabling or disabling the bridge functionality.

methods.name: manage_bridge
methods.description: Handles the management of a specific bridge identified by reference, configuring its operation mode, VLAN ID, and priority.
